scope: Four new current national records; no material refresh or historical correction.

changes.summary: The Federal Reserve inspector general documented renovation cost growth and governance failures but found no criminal-referral basis or administrative misconduct; Trump renewed legal pressure on Jerome Powell.
changes.duplicate_review: No same-event current record, source URL or recent maintenance item covered the inspector-general findings and the resulting presidential response.

changes.summary: South Korea announced plans for a major package of U.S. energy investments whose financing, approvals and construction remain unresolved.
changes.duplicate_review: Existing South Korea trade and investment references did not record this announced project package; prospective headline values were not treated as completed spending.

changes.summary: The Justice Department filed a judicial-misconduct complaint concerning at least seven Minnesota federal judges and requested investigation and DHS-case recusals.
changes.duplicate_review: No same-event current record or recent maintenance item covered the complaint; underlying immigration cases remain distinct litigation.

changes.summary: The Pentagon ordered a total 20 percent reduction in general and flag officer positions by January 1, 2027.
changes.duplicate_review: No current-layer record covered the expanded target; the May 2025 directive remains the prior baseline rather than a separate new event.
